name: FLYR
summary: Deep-learning revenue management and pricing for airlines; Virgin Atlantic reported more than a 10% uplift in seating revenue with FLYR's ancillary pricing.
paragraphs: Deep-learning revenue management and pricing for airlines; Virgin Atlantic reported more than a 10% uplift in seating revenue with FLYR's ancillary pricing.
whyItMatters: Moves airline pricing from static rules to machine-learning optimization, aimed at revenue managers and commercial teams.
